name: Brisbane CBD (core)
note: BCC King George Sq early bird $28 (enter 5:30-7am, exit 1-6pm). Daily max $49; private operators up to about $80; Wilson Flexi Saver prepay $26-$46 by car park.

name: Spring Hill
note: BCC Wickham Terrace early bird $26 (enter 5:30-9am, exit 1-7pm), daily max $49. Overlaps the CBD circle edge.

name: Fortitude Valley
note: No current all-day price found (Wilson early bird exists at selected Valley car parks, amount not published on fetched pages). Estimate in line with CBD council early bird; weeknight rate at 949 Ann St $27.

name: South Brisbane / South Bank
note: No all-day price found; estimate by analogy with CBD fringe. Check Wilson/Secure/Care Park rates for the specific garage.

name: Kangaroo Point
note: Mostly residential/building and limited paid stock; no sourced rate. Rough estimate.

name: Woolloongabba (Princess Alexandra Hospital)
note: Wilson PA Hospital car park, 199 Ipswich Rd: drive-up daily max $38 (3+ hrs). No early bird listed. Staff concession/permit rates not found.

name: Herston (Royal Brisbane and Women's Hospital)
note: Wilson RBWH car park, 20 Butterfield St: drive-up daily max $49. A 2023 hospital handout cited $40 at the Cornerstone car park; hospital staff concessions exist but amounts not found.

name: Kelvin Grove (QUT)
note: QUT casual rate 9-12 h about $40 at Kelvin Grove ($42 for 12-24 h), from search summary of QUT parking page (page itself returned 403, year not confirmed). QUT ID holders get discounts.

name: Gardens Point (QUT)
note: QUT casual 9-12 h about $85 ($90 for 12-24 h). Most commuters use cheaper CBD early bird parking nearby instead. Year not confirmed.

name: St Lucia (UQ)
note: 2026 casual caps: visitors blue zone $8.20/day, grey zone $11.50/day, premium casual zone $41.50/day; staff blue $6.40, grey $9.10. Staff drive-up daily option exists, price not found. Permit holders pay far less per day.

name: Milton
note: No sourced all-day rate; estimate. Much office parking is tenant-provided.

name: Toowong
note: No sourced all-day rate; estimate. Shopping centre and street parking mixed.

name: Newstead
note: No sourced all-day rate; estimate. Heavy use of tenant-provided parking.

name: Bowen Hills
note: BCC meter zone example: 3 h max, $6.85/h weekday (unusable for all day). Off-street all-day price not found; estimate.

name: Brisbane Airport (staff)
note: Staff parking is allocated through the employer's on-airport system; no public rate published. Contact staff.carparking@bne.com.au. Figure is a rough guess, many staff pay little or nothing.

name: Chermside (Westfield)
note: Third-party estimate: roughly $10 all day for shoppers after free hours; Westfield staff parking likely free or permit-based. Not confirmed by Westfield.

name: Indooroopilly
note: Indooroopilly Shopping Centre: first 3 h free, then escalating to a $30 daily max (7-8 h). Account holders get 4 h free. Staff likely use separate permits.
